decisions.reason: A startup accelerator program falls outside the firm's machinery and recycling engineering knowledge base, so the firm has little related knowledge to interpret results and improve it, and its resources are better spent on core plant development.

The bio-based bitumen binder ties loosely to the firm's material-conversion know-how and could benefit from its in-house R&D, but it targets a distant construction-materials market where absorptive capacity is limited, making it a marginal keep.

The infectious waste decontamination plant builds directly on the firm's modular WASTX plant engineering and is co-developed with partner ERMAFA, giving the firm strong related knowledge to assimilate market feedback and refine it.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant sits squarely in the firm's core decentralized plastic-recycling expertise and manufacturing know-how, so the firm is well placed to learn from early results and improve it.
